records.title: Colloquium in the History and Philosophy of Science
records.header: HPS 400 Colloquium in the History and Philosophy of Science (5) NSc/SSc
records.text: HPS 400 Colloquium in the History and Philosophy of Science (5) NSc/SSc Examines issues from the perspectives of both history and philosophy. Prerequisite: either HSTCMP 311, HSTCMP 312, HSTCMP 313, HSTCMP 314, HSTCMP 315, HSTCMP 317, HSTCMP 318, or HSTCMP 412; either PHIL 350, PHIL 360, PHIL 450, PHIL 460, PHIL 464, PHIL 466, PHIL 473, PHIL 481, PHIL 482, or PHIL 483.
